freeze.text: {name} is in a freeze window, so any change needs an explicit exception.

history.text: This kind of change has broken {name} before: {repeats}.

no_rollback.text: No rollback plan for a {tier}-tier service. The usual rollback is "{rollback}"; confirm it really undoes this change.

no_monitoring.text: No monitoring plan. Watch {watch} through every rollout stage.

config_drift.text: {name} config comes from {config_source}; diff staging and prod values before and after.

no_deploy_plan.text: No deploy plan, and {n_down} services sit downstream ({down}). Ship backward-compatible first and stage the rollout.

degraded.text: Degraded right now: {degraded}. A change on a degraded path hides the cause of the next failure.

rollback.text: Rollback plan: "{rollback_plan}". Rehearse it in staging and time it before the window.

dependencies.text: Downstream services that feel a failure here: {down}.
